gaps.lead: Only after reading the letter twice did it make sense.
gaps.sentence: The letter ___ sense until he had read it twice.
gaps.explanation: It didn't make sense until… = it made sense only after…

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he never reads instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he never reads = too impatient to read.

gaps.lead: I only understood the joke much later.
gaps.explanation: After 'only + time phrase' at the front, invert: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect: she had never been.

gaps.lead: My advice is to check the contract carefully.
gaps.explanation: had better + infinitive (without to): had better check.

gaps.lead: 'Would you like me to carry that?' he offered.
gaps.explanation: offer to do something: offered to carry.
